mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and federal funds rate over the past month signals strong economic growth with tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and FEDFUNDS both rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and retail sales over the past month indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that suppresses corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO and RSAFS both fall, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past month indicates a weakening supply chain and reduced economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
